decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1	The proposal represents an unsatisfactory development of the site that would provide cramped and unsatisfactory living accommodation for future residents through inadequate accommodation, lack of adequate private usable amenity space and inadequate provision for people with disabilities contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.3.1 (Access and facilities for people with disabilities), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and associated supplementary planning guidance

Condition : 2 - 2	The proposal provides insufficient on-site parking in an area of high on-street parking demand and its access layout would give rise to conditions harmful to the safety and free flow of pedestrian and vehicle traffic contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) and T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development) and associated supplementary planning guidance

Condition : 3 - 3	The provision of insufficient on-site parking in an area of high on-street parking demand and the unsatisfactory alteration to the layout of the existing house at No 90 Linkfield would be harmful to neighbours' living through increased parking demand in the area and unacceptable loss of light and outlook to the adjoining living room conditions contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) and ENV-B.1.1 (New Development)

Condition : 4 - 4	The design, scale, layout and siting of the building and the inadequate proposed landscaping would not respect its context and (in the absence of a full site survey) appears likely to result in the loss of mature trees, so would be harmful to the street scene and the setting of the adjoining locally listed building, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 and ENV-B.2.6 (Identification and Protection of Buildings of Local Townscape Character) and ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character)
description: Demolition of the single garage and erection of a three storey extension to provide 3 self contained flats adjacent to the existing house.
